from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Optional

class UpdateSectionParams(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(..., description="The name of the section to update")
    opt_fields: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Optional fields to include in the response")
    opt_pretty: Optional[bool] = Field(False, description="Whether to return the response in a pretty format")

class InstantiateProjectParams(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(..., description="The name for the new project to be instantiated")
    team_gid: str = Field(..., description="The team inclusion for the new project")
    opt_fields: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Optional fields to include in the response")
    opt_pretty: Optional[bool] = Field(False, description="Whether to return the response in a pretty format")

class DuplicateProjectParams(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(..., description="The new name for the duplicated project")
    team_gid: str = Field(..., description="The team for the duplicated project")
    opt_pretty: Optional[bool] = Field(False, description="Whether to return the response in a pretty format")

class UpdateProjectParams(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(..., description="The new name for the project")
    color: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="The color of the project")
    opt_fields: Optional[str] = Field(None, description="Optional fields to include in the response")
    opt_pretty: Optional[bool] = Field(False, description="Whether to return the response in a pretty format")

class CreateProjectParams(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(..., description="The name of the new project")
    team_gid: str = Field(..., description="The team ID for where the new project should be placed")
    workspace_gid: str = Field(..., description="The workspace ID for where the new project should be created")
    opt_pretty: Optional[bool] = Field(False, description="Whether to return the response in a pretty format")
